game.label: mh3u-port: your decrypted USA folder of Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate (Wii U), title id 0005000010118300. It must contain code, content and meta. Keep the v32 update folder (title id 0005000e10118300) next to it, in the same parent folder.

exit_codes.2: The game stopped. The last lines say why (it called exit, or a check such as too many system calls failed).

settings.label: Window
settings.help: A window, or borderless fullscreen. Big Picture starts fullscreen until you pick Windowed.

settings.label: Internal resolution
settings.help: 1x is the Wii U's own size. Higher is sharper and costs more.

settings.label: Keyboard and mouse
settings.help: WASD and the mouse as the camera. Off leaves the mouse as the GamePad's touch screen.

settings.label: Face buttons
settings.help: Xbox keeps the pad's A as the game's A. Nintendo swaps A with B and X with Y.

settings.label: Controller in background
settings.help: Off when RecompLauncher starts the game, so its overlay can use the controller. On keeps the pad working while this window is in the background.

settings.label: Wishlist in the item menu
settings.help: Shows the wishlist's status in the game's item menu. Needs a build translated with the current hooks.

settings.label: Mods row in the start menu
settings.help: Hold Right Shift or ZL in the start menu and Gestures becomes Mods. Needs a build translated with the current hooks.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: The game's save folder, next to the translated build.
